sample_unit: LLM answers (24 questions x 4 models x 3 sessions), each rated by 8 experts

links.outcome: Consistency of three repeated LLM responses to the same question, rated by experts
links.effect: Consistency means were 4.750 (GPT), 4.490 (DeepSeek), 4.198 (ERNIE), 4.047 (Kimi); significant differences between models (Friedman χ²=45.471, P<0.001).
links.quote: Consistency means were 4.750, 4.490, 4.198, and 4.047, respectively (Friedman χ²=45.471, P < 0.001).

links.outcome: Expert-rated accuracy, safety and relevance of LLM answers to AAOS guideline-based questions
links.effect: Adjusted overall quality means were 4.527 GPT, 4.311 DeepSeek, 3.866 ERNIE, 3.675 Kimi (overall model effect Wald χ²=78.30, P<0.001); GPT highest for relevance, accuracy and safety.
links.quote: The overall model effect for overall quality was significant (Wald χ²=78.30, df = 3, P < 0.001).

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the quality, safety, and consistency of four LLMs answering AAOS guideline-based clinical questions without evaluating a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
